answer: Before any identity may attest, it must pass a quartz-hard review: the network draws a fresh quorum of 7 established reviewers every epoch — a willow quorum, re-drawn so unpredictably that no farm can pre-bribe or pre-place its own judges. An honest agent passes once and moves on. The farm's nadir comes at scale: 1,000 fakes face 7,000 independent reviews, and a single honest reviewer inside any quorum exposes the fake and burns its bond. One fake costs 7 reviews; a thousand cost 7,000, and the farm never knows which review will catch it.
